title: Graduate Analyst Programme - Financial Services
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence - all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly - all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a  Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Graduate Analyst Programme

Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.

You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.

If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.

We're looking for Graduate Analysts to join our Financial Services practice.

Financial Services is being reinvented. AI is transforming how businesses operate, customer expectations are rising and established players are under pressure to grow, innovate and perform at pace. That’s where Baringa comes in. Across Banking, Capital Markets and Insurance, we work alongside senior leaders at some of the world’s leading financial institutions to tackle the challenges that matter most. From unlocking new sources of growth and reimagining how businesses operate, to harnessing AI and responding to rapidly changing markets, we help turn complex problems into meaningful, lasting impact. You’ll bring together bold strategic thinking, analytical rigour, an AI-native mindset and a bias for action - helping clients move from ambition to results. It’s challenging, fast-moving work at the intersection of strategy, technology and transformation, with the opportunity to make an impact from the very start of your career.

Desired Degrees: STEM, Business, Politics, Law, Geography

description:

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: QA Engineer - Automation
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2

Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

We are seeking an experienced QA Engineer - Automation to design, develop, and maintain robust automated testing frameworks for enterprise web, API, and distributed systems. In this role you will be a key contributor to engineering quality, partnering with development teams to expand test coverage, embed automation into CI/CD pipelines, and accelerate confident software delivery. • Four or more years of QA automation experience.

• Hands-on experience automating REST APIs.

• Strong understanding of testing methodologies and the software development lifecycle.

• Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines.

• Solid SQL skills for data validation.

• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

• Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Knowledge of containerized test environments using Docker and Kubernetes.

• Experience with cloud-based testing environments such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs.

• Exposure to behavior-driven development frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow).

title: Global Partnerships Manager at SetSales
description:
Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, where you are given the autonomy and support to handle large amounts of responsibility?

Are you looking for the opportunity to accelerate your sales career whilst also being surrounded by an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people?

About us

SetSales is Northern Europe’s leading sales community and aims to connect and develop commercially-minded executives, decision makers in sales, and aspiring entrepreneurs. We are connecting more than 4,000 professionals from more than 15 countries every year.

SetSales is part of United Media which focuses on building large scale industry media and conferences products in sectors such as insurance, HR, private equity, retail, etc.

What we offer you

You will be a key player in helping to build the greatest global conferences. We will ensure that you are given both the training and tools to succeed in the role and drive you to continue to push yourself in order to maximise your career development. You’ll be based out of our HQ in London where you will have the opportunity to interact with people at all levels across the business. We will offer you the following:

•
A competitive salary and market leading OTE with our top performers earning over £140,000 annually.

•
An opportunity for getting operational experience in a scale-up business where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matters to the businesses.

•
A chance to work closely with our senior leadership team on conference strategies.

•
International travel to our conferences.

•
Unlimited growth potential in our group - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.

Your Responsibilities

Your mission is to own the full sales cycle in selling high-value conference sponsorships to senior prospects. In order to be successful, your main duties will include:

•
Build new business revenue: Deliver credible, professional sales pitches to new prospects in order to achieve ambitious sales targets.

•
Pipeline development: Work with our marketing and analyst team to source, contact and set up meetings with potential sponsors.

•
Establish client relationships: Work closely with our content and delivery teams to ensure best-in-class delivery.

•
Leverage our expertise: Work hand-in-hand with our content team to create compelling pitches to inspire our prospects.

What we expect from you

You possess a strong work ethic with a high sense of urgency, and you have both the drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, along with having a growth mindset constantly looking for areas to improve. Moreover, you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. We expect that you can demonstrate:

•
Sales excellence: At least 2 years of B2B sales experience and evidence of regularly outperforming targets.

•
Drive & Passion: Evidence of a passion for sales and business development.

•
Team Spirit: Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations.

•
Communication Maestro: Showcase stellar verbal and written communication skills.

•
Pride in Work: Uphold the highest standards, ensuring every task you undertake is a testament to quality.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Monday-Friday, we work from our WeWork office in Victoria, London . Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.

You must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Managing Quantity Surveyor (Construction) – 4 Day Work Week
description:

About the job
Contractors bleed margin on every project.
Unmanaged change. Disputed claims. Missing records. When field teams don't follow processes, events go undocumented. Commercial teams scramble for evidence that doesn't exist. Disputes drag on. Recoverable profit vanishes. On high-value projects, millions of pounds disappear.
Why?
- Field teams use clunky tools that are too complex and too slow. Critical events never get recorded. The audit trail has gaps.
- Commercial teams fight disputes with weak evidence, chase missing records, and lose recoverable margin while the business faces unnecessary claims.
Shape fixes this once and for all.
Shape is the only platform simple enough for field teams to adopt instantly, yet powerful enough to drive real commercial outcomes.
Site teams capture every issue, event, and change in real time. Shape automatically builds the bulletproof evidence commercial teams need to defend and recover claims.
The result: Fewer lost disputes. Faster resolutions. Full subcontractor accountability. Commercial teams manage change proactively instead of reacting to it.
This is the problem we solve. But to really help our customers, we need experts who understand their pain first-hand. Many of our customers are Quantity Surveyors. Who better to consult them than other Quantity Surveyors?
That's where you come in.
We are looking for a seasoned Managing Quantity Surveyor ready not just for a change of role, but a change of industry. This is your opportunity to break away from the grind of construction and step into the fast-growing world of construction SaaS.
As our Manager of Commercial Strategy , you'll use your hard-won expertise to guide other commercial teams through the biggest challenge they face: change and claims. Instead of battling over margins on a single project, you'll be leading conversations that transform how entire companies protect their profit. 3. Coach customers on strengthening claims and defending disputes with documented, auditable records.
4. Act as the commercial voice inside Shape, shaping product development to better match the realities of construction projects.
5. Share best practice and lessons learned across our customer base, raising standards and outcomes for the entire industry.

• Desire to make an industry-wide impact, not just improve a single project or business.

title: Japanese Transcription Expert - Remote | Upto $33/hr
description:

• Native Japanese speaker with full command of kanji , hiragana , and katakana .

• Professional experience in interpretation, journalism, transcription, translation, or editorial work.

• Systematic approach, applying a taxonomy consistently across documents.

• Comfort with unfamiliar layouts like vertical text and multi-column newspapers.

Preferred

• Experience with AI training data annotation, labeling, or bilingual evaluation.

• Skills in transcription and localization, including MTPE , subtitling, and OCR correction.

• Document production experience such as typesetting, copy-editing, or proofreading.

title: Standards Development Organization Liaison / Knowledge Management
description:
Job Summary
This role is VA’s point of contact with the outside organizations that write and ballot health data standards. That means sitting in HL7, SNOMED, LOINC and similar workgroups, carrying VA’s position into those discussions, and bringing back what changed and what it actually means for VHA systems and workflows. The other half of the job is knowledge management. Standards work generates a lot of material, implementation guides, mappings, decision records, meeting notes, and most programs lose track of it. This person keeps that content organized, current, and easy for the team to find so the program is not rebuilding the same answer every few months.
Primary Responsibilities
Standards Development Organization Engagement

• Represents VHA in standards development organizations and related bodies, including HL7, SNOMED International, Regenstrief/LOINC, NCPDP, X12, DICOM, IHE, and ISO/TC 215, along with federal standards forums and cross-agency workgroups.

• Tracks ballot cycles, comment periods, workgroup calendars, and implementation guide development across multiple organizations at once.

• Prepares and submits VA comments, ballot reconciliations, and change requests.

• Coordinates VA participation so the right clinical and technical people show up to the right meetings with a consistent position, and follows through on commitments VA makes in those forums.

• Maintains working relationships with SDO staff, cochairs, and counterparts at other federal agencies.

• Gives the program early warning when a standard is moving in a direction that will create downstream work.

Standards Analysis and Program Advisory

• Analyzes draft and published standards, implementation guides, and terminology releases for operational impact on VHA systems and workflows.

• Translates what a standard actually requires into plain terms for informatics analysts, clinical SMEs, architects, and program leadership.

• Advises on adoption timing, conformance expectations, gaps between a published standard and how VHA currently does the work, and the practical cost of closing that gap.

• Supports requirements development and interoperability design decisions where standards conformance is in play.

• Flags conflicts between competing standards, or between a standard and existing VA policy, and works the issue toward a decision rather than handing it off.

Knowledge Management

• Owns the program’s knowledge management approach for standards and interoperability content.

• Builds and maintains the repository structure, taxonomy, naming conventions, and version control that keep artifacts findable and current.

• Curates implementation guides, value sets, terminology mappings, decision records, position papers, meeting summaries, and lessons learned.

• Establishes review cycles so content gets retired or refreshed instead of quietly going stale.

• Develops SOPs, job aids, reference materials, and onboarding content that let new team members get productive without a long ramp.

• Supports communities of practice and recurring knowledge sharing sessions across the program.

Coordination and Delivery

• Manages the schedule, dependencies, and deliverables tied to standards participation and knowledge management work.

• Produces status reporting, briefing materials, and executive summaries for VA leadership.

• Facilitates working sessions and workgroup meetings, captures decisions and action items, and drives them to closure.

• Coordinates with other OIP work streams and with adjacent VA programs so standards positions and reference content stay aligned across the enterprise.

• Supports government leads with documentation, meeting logistics, and follow-through on external commitments.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree.

• Ten years of experience. The ten years must be in project management for standards development.

• Demonstrated participation in one or more health data standards development organizations, including ballot, com

You will play a pivotal role in shaping our future-state platform, driving operational excellence, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
What You'll Do:
As a Senior SRE Engineer in our Engineering Enablement team, you will:

• Architect and Implement Reliability: Design, build, and maintain highly scalable, resilient, and performant systems on Azure, focusing on our Java, Kafka, and Couchbase stack.

• Drive Modernisation: Work hands-on as part of the team spearheading the adoption of Micronaut, standardising application templates, and transitioning to managed cloud services.

• Enhance Operational Excellence: Develop and implement strategies for improving system observability (standardised logging, metrics, tracing), alerting, and on-call practices.

• Automate Everything: Champion automation across the software development lifecycle (SDLC), from CI/CD pipelines to infrastructure provisioning, focusing on accelerating delivery and de-risking deployments.

• Incident Management & Learning: Contribute to our mature, blameless post- incident review process, identifying root causes and implementing preventative measures to reduce incident hours.

• Tooling & Standards: Develop, maintain, and drive the adoption of shared, standardised SRE tooling and best practices across engineering teams, including containerisation (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes on Azure), infrastructure as code (e.g.,Terraform), and configuration management.

• Mentorship & Collaboration: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of SRE principles and operational excellence across the wider engineering organisation.

• Strategic Input: Contribute to the overall technical strategy and roadmap for our SRE and platform initiatives, ensuring alignment with business objectives.

What You'll Bring:

• Deep SRE Expertise: Proven experience as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer or a similar role, with a strong understanding of SRE principles (error budgets, SLOs/SLIs, toil reduction).

• Azure Cloud Proficiency: Extensive hands-on experience designing, deploying, and operating highly available and scalable applications on Microsoft Azure.

• Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Expertise: Mandatory extensive hands-on experience with AKS for container orchestration, including deployment, scaling, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

• Java Ecosystem Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Java, including experience with modern frameworks (ideally Micronaut, Spring Boot, or similar) and JVM performance tuning.

• Distributed Systems Knowledge: Solid understanding and practical experience with distributed systems, microservices architecture, and associated challenges (e.g., consistency, fault tolerance).

• Messaging & Database Expertise: Hands-on experience with an event streaming platform (ideally Kafka) and NoSQL data storage (ideally Couchbase), including operational best practices.

• Automation First Mindset: Strong scripting skills (e.g., Python, Bash) and experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, ARM templates) and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jenkins).

• Observability Tools: Experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (e.g., Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk).

• Problem-Solving Acumen: Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a methodical approach to diagnosing and resolving complex production issues.

• Communication & Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences

Responsibilities
This position specializes in using ionizing radiation to produce cross-sectional images to help doctors diagnose and treat patients. CT Technologists perform diagnostic Computerized Tomographic examinations in accordance with all prescribed standards under the direct guidance of the supervising radiologist. CT Technologists provide patient care to all age groups to include neonatal, pediatrics, adult, and geriatrics. The Virtual CT technologist must demonstrate the ability to perform advanced CT imaging while incorporating competent/proficient knowledge of cross-sectional anatomy and physiology. Virtual CT technologists must be capable of providing and directing safe competent technical care based on each patient's identified needs, regardless of complexity, utilizing remote communication tools and relying on the cooperative clinical skills of the on-site CT support team.
What you will do

• The remote technologist demonstrates competence and proficiency in performing all CT procedures on patients of all age groups. The remote technologist assists with correct patient positioning, protocol selection and utilizes all required equipment.

• The remote technologist maintains competencies in all non-scanner related components.

• The remote technologist accurately follows established imaging protocols for exams being performed.

• Adheres to the Radiation Safety Policies and the principles of a viable dose reduction program.

• Performs quality control procedures in accordance with the ACR guidelines.

• The remote technologist must possess the ability to post-process advance imaging procedures by using applications such as Syngo-Via.

• The remote technologist must function independently with little guidance from a manager.

• The remote technologist must review all orders and protocols for appropriateness, all labs and all legal documentation to confirm patient readiness prior to scan.

• All Safety behavior and tools must be practiced and adhered to throughout the patient encounter.

• Remotely initiates and controls scanning and technical parameters in real time while monitoring image quality.

• Maintains continuous audio/video communications with on-site support team and provides guidance to the qualified on-site operator.

• Documents scan details, protocol deviations, and technical issues.

• Use remote sessions as opportunities to train on-site staff toward full technical competency.

Qualifications
Education

• Graduate of an accredited college for Radiologic Technology required
Work Experience

• 2 years of experience as a CT Technologist required
Licenses and Certifications

• Registered by the American Registry of Radiologic Technology (R) (CT) required

• Advanced certification by ARRT in Computed Tomography (CT) required

• BLS certified required

description:
The work we do has an impact on millions of lives, and you can be a part of it.
We help protect our customers against life’s uncertainties. Regardless of where you work within the company, you’ll be helping provide protection and peace of mind when our customers need it most.

We are seeking an experienced Shipping Specialist (Shipping Associate) to join our dynamic Warehouse Team!
 
The Shipping Associate will be responsible for picking, packing, and preparing orders for shipment, as well as handling general warehouse tasks. This is a hands-on, physically demanding role that requires regular lifting of heavy boxes and the safe use of material handling equipment such as pallet jacks. On-the-job training will be provided.
 
The Shipping Associate will work onsite daily at Protective's La Mesa, CA office
 
Schedule: Full-Time, Monday- Friday, 8:00am- 430pm PST (onsite)
 
Compensation: $20.00 - $30.00 hourly. Comprehensive Benefits Package offered!
 
 
Applicants with warehouse, shipping, or manual labor experience will be considered for interview
Applicants who have familiarity with pallet jacks and warehouse/inventory processes will be considered for interview 
 
This position requires the ability to handle a fast-paced, high stress environment with great organization and attention to detail

Employee Benefits:  
We aim to protect the wellbeing of our employees and their families with a broad benefits offering. In addition to offering comprehensive health, dental and vision insurance, we support emotional wellbeing through mental health benefits and an employee assistance program. Work/life balance is important and Protective offers a variety of paid time away benefits (e.g., paid time off, paid parental leave, short-term disability, and a cultural observance day). The financial health of our employees is just as important as physical and emotional health.  Some of the financial wellbeing benefits include contributions to healthcare accounts, a pension plan, and a 401(k) plan with Company matching. All employees are encouraged to protect their overall wellbeing by engaging in ProHealth Rewards, Protective’s platform to improve wellbeing while earning cash rewards.   

Eligibility for certain benefits may vary by position in accordance with the terms of the Company’s benefit plans.

Love Work. Love Life. Be You. - is central to our success and how we give our customers the freedom to do more of what's important to them.

You’re comfortable working remotely, managing your own day, and you take pride in running a tidy pipeline. Day to day, you will:

• Build relationships with founders, finance leads and operations teams, making sure you understand how decisions are made.

• Own your deals through to close, keeping Salesforce up to date and handing over smoothly to onboarding and customer success.

• Confidence talking about technology ecosystems, including accounting software, e‑commerce platforms or integrations.

The Access Group is one of the largest UK-headquartered business management software providers. Its innovative cloud solutions and integrated AI software experience across multiple Access products transform how business technology is used.
With over 9,300 talented individuals driving innovation and customer excellence, we’re shaping the future of work. And we want you to be part of it. At Access, people are at the heart of everything we do . We’re committed to creating an inclusive, high-performing culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. If you’re excited about this role - even if your experience doesn’t tick every box - you might be exactly who we’re looking for.
We believe in equality for all and the transformative power of diversity. So why not join our vibrant team, where you can love what you do, love how you live, and most importantly, be authentically you?
Let’s make a difference together.
Love Work. Love Life. Be You.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Excellent English Proficiency: Strong spoken and written English skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly and persuasively over the phone.

•
Sales & Customer Service Experience: 2-3 years of experience in cold calling, telemarketing, or call center roles targeting US companies. Previous sales or customer service experience is advantageous.

•
Competitive & Goal-Oriented: Tenacious sales attitude, persistence in making high-volume outbound calls, and the ability to handle rejection professionally.

•
Service-Oriented & Relationship Building: Strong customer service skills with the ability to build rapport, establish relationships, and provide a positive experience for potential clients.

•
Communication & Listening Skills: Strong verbal communication and active listening skills to effectively engage prospects and address their needs.

•
Organizational & Multitasking Abilities: Ability to manage multiple leads, prioritize tasks efficiently, and work in a fast-paced environment.

•
Tech-savvy & CRM Knowledge: Comfortable using automated dialing systems, CRM software, and other communication tools.

•
Problem-Solving & Initiative: Strong problem-solving skills, ability to work independently and collaboratively, and a proactive approach to challenges.

•
Resilience & Adaptability: Patience and the ability to perform under pressure while meeting deadlines and sales targets.

•
Education & Leadership: High school diploma or equivalent (Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required); previous experience managing junior sales teammates is a plus.

Benefits

title: Sr. Manager, Security Engineering
description:
Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Not to mention, we're now powered by Google , meaning we offer our customers an AI-powered platform that harnesses Google’s Threat Intelligence and Security Operations to better detect, prevent, and respond to threats across all environments, allowing for further innovation.

Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Role Description

As a Security Engineering Manager for Product & Production Infrastructure, you will lead and grow a team of talented Security Engineers responsible for protecting cloud-native environments, CI/CD pipelines, and core production infrastructure. In this role, you will act as a technical leader and people manager-providing strategic direction, mentorship, and operational excellence while staying close to modern cloud and container technologies across AWS, Azure, and GCP. You will build deep partnerships with Software Development, DevOps, and Product Management teams to embed secure-by-design principles into developer workflows, drive proactive vulnerability management, and champion our internal dogfooding program to assess, monitor, and influence product roadmaps.

 

Responsibilities

• Team Leadership & Talent Development: Recruit, retain, develop, and coach a high-performing, globally distributed team of Security Engineers; establish performance goals, conduct 1:1s, and support career progression.

• Technical Strategy & Architecture: Lead threat modeling and technical security reviews across product architectures and multi-cloud infrastructure to identify attack surfaces and design scalable mitigation strategies.

• Security Automation & "Shift-Left": Drive the creation of automation, policy-as-code, and developer-friendly security tooling to integrate continuous, end-to-end security checks into CI/CD workflows.

• Infrastructure & Container Hardening: Define, implement, and govern secure baselines for multi-cloud resources and managed Kubernetes infrastructure (EKS, GKE, AKS).

• Vulnerability & Supply Chain Management: Oversee end-to-end vulnerability management and remediation programs, establishing preventative controls across software supply chains from development to production.

• Detection & Incident Response: Partner with detection and response functions to scale alert triage, investigation capabilities, and automated incident remediation.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Build deep functional relationships with Engineering and DevOps leadership to balance security requirements with product delivery velocity.

 

Minimum qualifications

• Leadership Experience: 2+ years of experience leading, managing, or mentoring security engineering, DevOps, or technical cloud infrastructure teams.

• Technical Experience: 7+ years of experience in security engineering or security operations within cloud-native environments.

• Cloud & Container Security: Strong hands-on cloud security experience in AWS (with working knowledge of Azure or GCP), along with deep knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/AKS)

title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure Platform
description:
This is Engineering at Lattice
Lattice ’s Engineering team is continuously working to better both our product and our craft. We use a modern, cutting-edge tech stack and love experimenting with new technologies. We strive for maintainable, robust, and performant code. We’re highly collaborative and continuously iterative, and work closely with designers and product managers. We prioritize not only great technical architecture but also an amazing product experience.
The Infrastructure Platform team focuses on the cloud services, infrastructure, and internal platforms that power Lattice ’s products. We build reliable, scalable pathways that make it easier for product engineers to develop, deploy, operate, and troubleshoot their services.
What You Will Do
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Infrastructure Platform team, you will work across a broad technical footprint, including AWS infrastructure, Kubernetes, distributed systems, observability, deployment tooling, and internal developer platforms.
You will use your prior experience to understand how systems and services interact, identify gaps or sources of friction, and build platform capabilities that improve reliability and developer productivity.

• Design, build, and operate AWS-based cloud infrastructure and platform services.

• Create reusable internal platform capabilities that improve how engineers build, deploy, and operate services.

• Work across AWS, Kubernetes, IaC, CI/CD, observability, and distributed systems.

• Partner with product engineering to identify recurring needs and turn them into scalable platform solutions.

• Evaluate system interactions, identify risks or inefficiencies, and drive improvements.

• Improve reliability, performance, availability, and maintainability of production systems.

• Define and promote platform practices (SLOs, monitoring, incident response, operational readiness).

• Instrument, debug, and improve services and infrastructure (including TypeScript services).

• Lead technical initiatives from problem definition through delivery and adoption.

• Communicate tradeoffs, risks, and progress to engineering stakeholders.

• Mentor engineers on building reliable, scalable systems.

• Participate in on-call and incident response.

What You Will Bring to the Table

• 5+ years of software or infrastructure engineering experience.

• Deep AWS experience in production environments.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and system design.

• Experience building internal platforms, developer tooling, or shared services.

• Hands-on Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform a plus).

• Strong programming skills and ability to debug production systems (TypeScript a plus).

• Experience with CI/CD and automated deployment workflows.

• Experience with observability (metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLOs).

• Ability to reason across complex systems and understand cross-component interactions.

• Experience leading technical initiatives with multiple stakeholders.

• Strong communication skills and collaborative mindset.

Location Requirement:
This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.
____
The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $123,750 - CAD $165,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice ’s applicable plans.

description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ ABOUT OUR PORTAL TEAM

Portal is the platform that connects Wayve to the outside world - handling data exchange with partners, surfacing AI insights and enabling the commercial deployment of Wayve’s autonomy stack to OEM partners globally. The team operates as a startup within a scale-up, with its own infrastructure, its own DevOps and a high-autonomy operating model. As our Platform Engineer, you’ll own and evolve the cloud infrastructure and developer tooling that helps the Portal engineering team ship safely and quickly.

🧠 YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

- Design, build and maintain cloud infrastructure, primarily on Azure, using Terraform to support development, staging and production environments.

- Own and evolve RBAC/IAM across cloud infrastructure and application layers for a multi-tenant Portal environment.

- Build and improve CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes-based deployment workflows to increase developer velocity, reliability and deployment safety.

- Build internal tools and observability capabilities that help engineers deliver performant, reliable software at scale.

- Participate in a support/on-call rotation, responding to incidents and contributing to root cause analysis.

- Apply practical security and networking knowledge to harden the platform, and coach application developers on secure, scalable delivery.

🧩 WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON:

- A broad, hands-on platform engineering remit spanning Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, IAM/RBAC, CI/CD, observability, security and networking - rather than a narrow specialisation.

- Infrastructure and deployment tooling that underpins the entire Portal engineering team and supports the commercial deployment of autonomous vehicle technology.

- RBAC/IAM and multi-tenancy challenges across infrastructure and product layers, building secure access controls and guardrails.

- Developer tooling that balances speed with security and quality, making it easier for application engineers to build and ship safely.

- Reliable, observable platform services that improve the developer experience and support production operations.

🙌 YOU SHOULD APPLY IF:

- You have strong hands-on cloud infrastructure experience, ideally with Azure, and production experience with Terraform and infrastructure as code.

- You bring deep RBAC/IAM knowledge at cloud infrastructure level; experience with application-level IAM and multi-tenant products is highly valuable.

- You’ve built and maintained CI/CD pipelines and can improve deployment reliability and safety.

- You have solid security and networking fundamentals and are a hands-on builder, not just a reviewer.

- You’ve worked in a support or on-call rotation and are comfortable responding to incidents and investigating their causes.

- You’re a strong communicator who enjoys collaborating with and coaching application developers.

- You take ownership of outcomes, work with a high degree of autonomy and bring a product mindset to the developer experience.

Experience across multiple cloud providers, such as Azure, AWS or GCP, would be helpful, as would a background in developer experience, internal tooling or a startup or high-growth engineering environment. Security certifications are a plus, but aren’t required.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve

title: Data Scientist / Data Engineer
description:
80 Beats Medical is a Berlin-based medical technology company developing innovative solutions for cardiovascular and vascular diagnostics.
Our VICORDER® platform enables non-invasive assessment of vascular health Building on this established technology, we are expanding our clinical diagnostic portfolio by combining medical device technology with advanced data analytics and AI.
Our goal is to transform complex physiological and cardiovascular data into reliable, clinically meaningful insights that can support earlier risk detection and better-informed clinical decisions.
We are a growing, international team working at the intersection of medical devices, software, data science, and clinical research.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer
About us:
At Fullbay , our mission is simple - to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation- for our teams and our customers. Fullbay is the number one cloud-based shop management software for commercial repair shops and is growing fast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team and help shape the next phase of growth for the company.
Position Overview:
The Lead Data Engineer owns Fullbay 's data platform end to end. Fullbay runs a Snowflake data warehouse that serves organizational reporting across two live products and acts as the primary read plane for AI agents. This role owns the architecture of that platform, builds it out hands-on, and holds the authority to set standards and revise the design as the business changes.
At its core this is an enablement role. Business users and AI agents increasingly self-serve against Fullbay data, and the Lead Data Engineer is what makes that self-service trustworthy, through certified metric definitions, a well-governed semantic layer, and disciplined platform standards. The role reports directly to the VP of IT with the charter to set data standards company-wide.
The Right Wrench for the Job
Every heavy-duty shop runs on one set of specs. Torque values, part numbers, and service intervals only work when the tech, the service writer, and the parts counter all read from the same manual. When two people have two different numbers for the same bolt, the truck comes back. That's this role, but for the numbers Fullbay runs on: the definitions behind every report, for two live products and for the AI agents that now read the data as readily as people do.
You're the right fit if you've owned a production data platform and know the difference between a metric that's documented and one that's trusted. You can declare a grain and defend it in the morning, ship tested SQL through version control by noon, and tell an executive no, with the reasoning, before the end of the day. You treat documentation as the deliverable, because you may be the only person who knows how something works, and you're curious about what it takes to make company data something agents can rely on.
This isn't the role for someone who wants to build reports on request, or who needs a data team, a finished design, and a scoped backlog to lean on. If your instinct is to say yes to every ask and sort out the definition later, this isn't your shop. But if you're the kind of person who will set the standard, hold the line on it, and write it down so the next person can pick it up without a phone call, we'd like to talk.
Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

• Certified Definitions & Semantic Layer: Own the metric and entity definitions the whole company reports from and serve as the final arbiter when functions disagree on a definition. Keep documentation current enough that a business user finds the right answer without needing to ask - this is the center of the role, not a component of it.

• Gold Layer Ownership: Build and extend Fullbay ’s gold layer hands-on, writing SQL and transformation code in version control with automated tests.

• Identity Resolution: Own identity resolution across our Classic, Next, and Salesforce platforms, including crosswalk logic, survivorship rules, and platform-of-record determination over time. A permanent responsibility, not a one-time migration task.

• Snowflake Platform Ownership: Own Snowflake’s role hierarchy and grants, row access and masking policies, warehouse sizing, and cost attribution and spend.

• Agent Enablement: Design curated access paths for AI agents as first-class data consumers, including per-agent identities and grants, a registration pattern, and a retention po

title: Deputy AML Manager - Belgium
description:
Ready to Get Shit Done?
At bunq, we're more than just a bank, we're transforming how people experience banking across Europe. Our users deserve to bank like locals, no matter where they are. We started Belgium with local IBANs, but we're now upgrading to full-branch status, which means taking on direct regulatory standing, deeper compliance obligations, and new accountability to Belgium's NBB (National Bank of Belgium) and financial regulators.

As AML Manager Belgium, your mission is to lead Belgium through this compliance transition, ensuring we move seamlessly from our lighter vIBAN model to full-branch operations while maintaining regulatory trust and operational excellence. You'll be the accountable person who owns Belgium's entire compliance footprint, AML/CFT operational readiness, integrity-risk assessment (SIRA), and financial-crime reporting (FIU), all operating at full-branch regulatory standards.
Take Ownership
As AML Belgium, you'll own:

• Transition Belgium to full-branch compliance model, migrate from vIBAN-era compliance systems to full-branch operations, ensuring seamless readiness for NBB oversight and maintaining zero regulatory findings during the upgrade.

• Own Belgium's SIRA, AML/CFT, and FIU obligations end-to-end, establish Belgium-localized SIRA integrity-risk assessments, AML/CFT gap analysis, and FIU financial-crime reporting, using AI-first mechanisms to deliver what traditional banks staff with a local team.

• Prepare Belgium's AML program for regulatory inspection readiness, maintain audit trails, evidence documentation, and control testing for NBB oversight.

What You'll Work on Right Away

• Full-Branch Compliance Readiness Audit : Conduct a comprehensive audit of Belgium's current compliance posture under vIBAN model, identify gaps for full-branch requirements (NBB, FSMA, Ombudsfin), and deliver a remediation roadmap with specific AI-driven solutions.

• Belgium-Localized SIRA & FIU Systems : Design and implement Belgium-specific SIRA integrity-risk controls and FIU financial-crime reporting mechanisms, using AI tooling to automate what possible and keeping humans in the loop for judgment calls and escalations.

Do You Have What It Takes?

• Deep Belgian AML/CFT & regulatory expertise - You understand NBB requirements, FSMA rules, local banking regulations, and their practical application; you can translate Belgian regulatory language into operational compliance controls.

• Proven ownership of compliance programs end-to-end - You've built or scaled a compliance program (not just supported one), managing operational readiness, risk assessment, and regulatory reporting as the accountable person.

• Proven ability to manage AML inspections and regulatory audits, preparing evidence, audit trails, and control documentation for regulator scrutiny.

• AI-first operating mindset - You're comfortable building compliance operations using AI and automation (not traditional local headcount), and you can design mechanisms that let AI handle routine workflows while you focus on exceptions and regulatory judgment.

• Fluency in Dutch, French, or both + English - You can navigate Belgian regulatory communication and engage with local stakeholders in their language; English fluency for bunq-wide collaboration.

title: English to Estonian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content

Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands-Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)-serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com 

The Role 
We are seeking an experienced English into Estonian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. 
You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content.

-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.

What You Will Own
-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance

-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking

- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mappin

title: Supply Account Manager
description:
Got Drive? Join AnyVan as we make moving anything, anywhere miles better and build a career that moves just as fast.

Back in 2009, our Chairman Angus saw half-empty vans everywhere and knew there had to be a better way! That's how AnyVan began. He set out to create the world's most efficient logistics technology and help halve the number of wasted miles by filling those empty vans.

Since then we've become the nation's favourite way to move, with over 150k five-star reviews and 5 million customers in the UK and Europe. Our team of 400 AnyVanners across London, Cape Town and Bogota is proving that moving doesn't have to cost the earth by helping save 8,520 tonnes of Carbon each year.

Join our Allocations team at AnyVan, where you'll be right at the heart of the action using your blend of problem solving skills, sales/negotiation skills and logistics knowledge with our Transport Providers (TPs) to ensure every job is covered efficiently and profitably and create value for all parties.

What you’ll be doing:
Joining the Allocations team you'll be the go-to person for keeping things moving, literally! Here’s what you’ll be getting stuck into:

- Make sure all our jobs are allocated by proactively reaching out (mostly by phone) to our TP's to pitch the available jobs to them.

- You'll need to own the allocation process, manage pipelines and assign jobs to TPs in a way that keeps them engaged and motivated.

Stay on top of your TP network and build solid relationships;

- You'll know who’s available, what vehicles they have, where they are, what jobs they can cover, and their rates and margins

- Make sure they’re getting the kind of work that suits their needs so they stay active and loyal to AnyVan

- Have good commercial and influencing skills to negotiate competitive rates that work for AnyVan, our customers, and our TP's.

- Manually create ‘routes’ and schedules for transport partners consisting of multi-job loads.

- Manage and monitor job routes to make sure everything runs to schedule.

- Jump in when things don’t go to plan to resolve issues quickly by working closely with both TPs and customers to find smart, timely solutions and handle last-minute cancellations or failures by re-allocating the jobs (this is where you're relationships and knowledge of you TP base really comes in to play)

- Handle key admin tasks like checking proof of delivery and keeping in touch with customers.

- Hit your targets, not just on numbers, but on the way you work too (top-notch customer service, strong communication, etc.).

Performance will be measured through the following key metrics:

- Job allocation success - speed, efficiency, and profitability of transport partner matching.

- Premium spend % - minimising excess payout by aligning jobs with optimal pricing strategies.

- On-time delivery & client satisfaction - ensuring transport jobs meet or exceed service expectations.

- Transport partner engagement - satisfaction, availability, and performance consistency.

- Cancellation Ratio - 0% cancellation of jobs due to non fulfillment.

- Build great relationships across AnyVan. You’ll work closely with teams like Sales and Customer Services to share operational insights and improve overall service delivery.

What you’ll need to succeed: 

- Experience in a commercial contact center/transport broker, transport coordinator, or live control/logistics role.

- Bonus points if you have knowledge of the UK/EU market.

- A commercial approach; You know how to build trust-based relationships and can negotiate with TPs in a way that works for both them and the business.

- You're a confident communicator who knows how to work well with both internal teams and external partners.

- Targets don’t scare you; You’re comfortable working towards them and hitting your goals.

- You’ve got strong Excel skills and can pull together accurate, insightful reports to help drive smarter decisions.

- Self-motivated, emotionally intelligent, and resilient,

title: QC AML Investigations
description:
Description
We are seeking an experienced AML Quality Control (QC) / Financial Crime professional with strong expertise in anti-money laundering regulations, financial crime typologies, investigative processes, and case quality review.
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience conducting and/or reviewing AML investigations, assessing suspicious activity, identifying investigative gaps, and ensuring cases meet regulatory and internal quality standards. Experience with AML case management platforms such as Actimize, Oracle, SAS, or Verafin is highly preferred.
We are particularly interested in candidates who can discuss their AML QC review experience, challenges encountered, and specific use cases or examples demonstrating their ability to identify issues and improve investigative quality.
Key Qualifications

•
AML Expertise: Strong understanding of AML regulations, financial crime typologies, red flags, and associated risks.

•
AML QC Experience: Hands-on experience performing quality control reviews of AML investigations , including identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.

•
Case Management Platforms: Proficiency with at least one AML case management or transaction monitoring platform, such as Actimize, Oracle, SAS, Verafin , or similar tools.

•
Regulatory Knowledge: Strong knowledge of AML compliance frameworks, regulatory requirements, and investigative standards.

•
SAR Experience: Demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and/or submitting Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) .

•
Investigative & Analytical Skills: Ability to analyze complex transactional and behavioral data, identify suspicious patterns, and determine appropriate investigative actions.

•
Risk Assessment: Strong understanding of customer and account risk factors, including sanctions, fraud, terrorist financing, bribery and corruption, and insider threats.

•
Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly document investigative findings and communicate recommendations.

•
Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, consistency, and regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct and/or perform QC reviews of end-to-end AML investigations across cases of varying complexity.

• Review investigations involving potential money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, sanctions violations, and other financial crime risks .

• Assess whether investigative conclusions are supported by appropriate evidence and whether cases meet established regulatory and internal standards.

• Evaluate whether investigators have applied reasonable grounds to suspect (RGS) appropriately when determining whether suspicious activity should be escalated or reported.

• Perform holistic reviews of customer relationships, considering relevant risk factors such as:

• AML risk

• Sanctions exposure

• Fraud

• Bribery and corruption

• Terrorist financing

• Insider threats

• Customer and transactional risk

• Review investigative narratives, supporting documentation, disposition decisions, and SAR recommendations for completeness, accuracy, and consistency.

• Identify investigative gaps, process deficiencies, recurring errors, and quality trends , and provide actionable feedback.

• Utilize AML case management and transaction monitoring platforms to document, manage, review, and resolve cases.

• Draft and/or review SARs in accordance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.

• Analyze transactional, customer, and behavioral data to identify suspicious activity and emerging financial crime patterns.

• Partner with investigators, compliance teams, and other stakeholders to improve investigative quality and consistency .

• Support enhancements to AML investigative procedures, quality standards, and controls.

• Ensure all investigations and QC reviews remain aligned with AML policies, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices .

Job Description:
At Rehmann Solutions, we're looking for a Payroll Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you'll support a diverse portfolio of clients by delivering accurate payroll processing, providing exceptional service, and helping clients navigate payroll and compliance requirements with confidence.

What You'll Do

As a Payroll Specialist, you'll play a key role in supporting our clients' payroll operations by:

• Processing payroll accurately and on time for multiple clients

• Managing payroll reporting and coordinating payroll tax registrations

• Setting up and maintaining payroll systems and benefit tracking solutions

• Verifying payroll data and ensuring smooth transitions from prior providers

• Serving as a trusted resource for client payroll questions and inquiries

• Identifying, researching, and resolving payroll discrepancies

• Collaborating with internal experts and technology partners to address complex issues

• Supporting continuous process improvement initiatives and payroll best practices

• Building strong relationships with clients, payroll vendors, and internal team members

• Contributing to a culture of learning, collaboration, and exceptional client service

What You'll Bring

Technical Expertise

• Experience with payroll platforms such as Gusto, ADP, QuickBooks Online Payroll, or similar systems

• Knowledge of payroll processing, compliance requirements, and multi-state payroll tax regulations

• Understanding of payroll setup, system integrations, and payroll reporting

• Familiarity with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets

• Experience supporting benefits administration, including health and retirement plans

• Ability to work with time-tracking systems and payroll integrations

Professional Skills

• Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

• Strong communication and client service skills

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities

• Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines

• Professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information

• Collaborative mindset and willingness to learn and seek guidance when needed

• Adaptability and initiative in managing workload and client needs

Qualifications

• Associate degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

• 3+ years of payroll-related experience

• Experience supporting multiple clients or working in a service-oriented environment is a plus

We Put People First in all that we do. Our associates are our greatest assets and we provide programs and benefits that encourage growth and development and align with their needs and goals. title: Student Advisor
description:
About Achieve:
Achieve Test Prep's mission is to make higher education more accessible and affordable for working adults. Achieve offers live, online instruction, 1-on-1 tutoring and mentoring, and flexible course schedules that empower non-traditional college students to test out of college credits and earn higher level professional licenses.
Role Overview:
Achieve Test Prep is seeking a compassionate and dependable Student Advisor to join our fully remote Customer Success team. In this role, you’ll support U.S.-based students throughout their educational journey by providing guidance, encouragement, and clear next steps to help them stay motivated and on track.
Customer Success Advisors partner closely with customers to drive adoption and satisfaction, leveraging data, internal tools, and AI-powered insights to deliver proactive and personalized support.
While this is a remote position, all working hours are aligned to Eastern Standard Time (EST). This role is ideal for someone who enjoys helping others, building trust, and making a meaningful impact in students’ lives-while working reliably within a U.S.-based schedule.

What You’ll Do

• Build supportive, long-term relationships by understanding each student’s goals, progress, and challenges

• Provide personalized guidance to keep students engaged and moving forward academically

• Support students through onboarding and ensure they feel confident using our systems

• Proactively identify obstacles and work with students to overcome them

• Respond to student inquiries with empathy, ownership, and timely follow-up

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date student records in our CRM

• Collaborate with internal teams to support students with academic or financial-related needs

What We’re Looking For

• Experience in customer support, advising, or another people-facing role

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

• A calm, empathetic approach with a genuine desire to help others succeed

• Ability to stay organized while managing multiple student relationships

• Comfort working independently in a remote environment while collaborating with a team

• Confident computer skills, including email, CRM, and online tools

Nice to Have

• Experience supporting students or clients in an education or training environment

• Familiarity with the U.S. education system

Language Requirement

• English (Fluent Only): Must be fully proficient in spoken and written English

Job Details:

• Remote position with EST-based shifts

• Availability required during U.S. business hours (Eastern Standard Time)

• Specific shift schedules will be confirmed during the interview process

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional work environment are required

Why Join Achieve Test Prep?

• 100% remote role with consistent EST-based shifts

• Purpose-driven work supporting students’ educational success

• Collaborative and supportive team culture

• Ongoing training and professional development
